description: This file defines functions to create and load configuration settings for testing IRC extensions in a Vitest testing environment. It imports external dependencies, provides utility functions for pattern loading from environment variables, and constructs a specific Vitest configuration object.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns for tests from environment variables, defaulting to process.env.

methods.name: export function createExtensionIrcVitestConfig( createExtensionIrcVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for IRC extension tests, with default patterns and setup files.
